text:
elaine: Heads-up: new external pentest next month. Need to finalize evidence export shape, KMS access model, and retest booking rules before kickoff.

devin: Proposal: bundle evidence per-window as tar.gz, include a checksum file (SHA256SUMS) and a detached signature (.sig) signed by our signing key. That keeps integrity and non-repudiation.

omar: Sounds good. I prefer ndjson inside the tar for logs and a small index.json for quick metadata lookup. Index should include: file, start_iso, end_iso, service, sha256, signer_id.

elaine: Index as JSON is fine but keep the format simple. Avoid nested objects so assessor tooling is simpler. Flat key-value per index line.

devin: For KMS, we cannot hand over key ARNs. Plan: generate encrypted artifact with envelope encryption using customer-managed key; create decrypt-session tokens that call our decrypt-service. Decrypt-service logs all requests to immutable-audit and returns plaintext over an mTLS stream.

omar: Agree. Also add a short-lived access token tied to the assessor's ephemeral role and the artifact id. Token TTL = 4h by default, extendable via approval.

elaine: Approval flow: security + infra-oncall required for extensions >4h. We'll log approver IDs into the manifest. No silent approvals.

security-bot: Reminder: generate a unique manifest_id for each engagement (format: pt-<engagement>-<unix>). Bots will tag evidence uploads with that id.

devin: Audit retention: evidence objects 90 days; audit events 18 months. Also we should keep a hashed index snapshot in long-term cold storage (immutable) for forensic needs.

omar: How do we handle remediation mapping? We want a field in the manifest: triage_ref which points to the issue tracker id. Include severity (low/med/high/critical) and CVSS numeric.

elaine: Add a mandatory short justification text for each triage item so assessors can't leave blanks. Helps PS and SRE prioritize.

ops-runbook: Checklist suggestion for squads claiming retest: 1) manifest_id present in ticket 2) artifacts uploaded + SHA validated 3) PR contains remediation description and unit/integration tests 4) rollback plan included 5) ephemeral role removed after fix.

devin: Retest slots: expose two windows via scheduler. First try at +7 days after ticket marked ready; second at +21 days. If more time needed, assessor can request a follow-up cycle but it's out-of-band.

omar: Automation: when manifest + linked PR + two passing CI checks are present, auto-label ticket `ready-for-retest` and enqueue to scheduler. No manual step unless someone overrides.

elaine: Important: make sure all timestamps in manifest are ISO8601 UTC. Also the manifest must include the export command used (git sha of the exporter script) for reproducibility.

security-bot: NOTE: export tool version must be included. Exporter sha tracked via header field: Exporter-SHA.

devin: Example export snippet we'll publish to assessors and squads:
```bash
./pt-export --window 2026-06-01T10:00:00Z/2026-06-01T14:00:00Z \
  --out /tmp/engagement-pt.tar.gz \
  && sha256sum /tmp/engagement-pt.tar.gz > /tmp/SHA256SUMS
```

omar: For object-lock: use GOVERNANCE mode for evidence objects with a retention window matching engagement + 30 days. For the long-term hashed index, set legal-hold until 2035-01-01.

elaine: Also requirement: ephemeral role audit events must include pre/post role list (who had access before grant and after revoke). Helps QA.

devin: Emergency extension policy: assessor requests extension in #eng-security with justification and tags infra-oncall. Allow 2-step approval within 30min SLA. All approved extensions are appended to the manifest and written to immutable-audit.

ops-runbook: We'll add a small runbook section: how to request decrypt-session, how to rotate session tokens, and how to revoke access mid-window.

omar: One more: retest evidence requirement. Teams must include a small sample capture showing the vulnerability is addressed (repro script + before/after logs). Not full logs, just minimal repro.

elaine: OK. Action owners: Devin - draft exporter+sigtool docs; Omar - implement decrypt-session + audit hooks; Ops-runbook - update ticket checklist and retest scheduler triggers. I'll schedule a 30m dry-run on Mon 2026-05-11 15:00 UTC.

devin: I'll push a PoC exporter by EOW.

omar: Starting decrypt-session prototype tomorrow.

ops-runbook: I'll add the checklist and automation rules to the template by Thu.

security-bot: Engagement "sable" scheduled: kickoff 2026-06-01T10:00:00Z. Auto-provision ephemeral roles 30m prior.

elaine: Thanks team. Quick follow-up: please keep messages short in the dry-run notes so assessors can parse the output easily. :sparkles:
